name: Accessibility Pack
author: Moritz Wallinger
description: Accessibility helpers for Ratchet & Clank with damage assists and a readable status overlay.

settings.name: Invulnerability
settings.description: Ignore normal damage handled by Hero_TakeDamage.

settings.name: Incoming damage
settings.description: Scale normal incoming damage. Values below 100 make the game more forgiving.

settings.name: Accessibility status overlay
settings.description: Show the active accessibility assists in a large high-contrast HUD line.
